_comment: Tests quarantined out of the PR and queue tiers; the nightly run still runs them. Each entry needs id, kind (go: '<package import path> <TopLevelTest>', pytest: node id), owner, reason and an ISO deadline. scripts/ci_quarantine.py check fails when a deadline has passed or the test no longer exists. Policy: docs/testing-guide.md#flaky-tests.

tests.reason: Hypothesis round-trip ran 10.5s against the 10s PR slow-test budget on a loaded runner (PR #893); needs a smaller example budget
